bethel.caption: Fields at Beitin, the traditional site of Bethel.
Bethel from the south, in an old photograph.

The Oak of Abraham in Hebron. Some traditions put the oaks of Mamre here.

The old city of Hebron, with the Cave of the Patriarchs at the back.

dan.caption: The mud-brick city gate at Tel Dan, from about 1750 BC. People call it Abraham's Gate.

dan.caption: The stone gate at Tel Dan, from the time of the kings of Israel.

dan.caption: A spring pool at Tel Dan. These springs feed the Jordan River.

salem.caption: Canaanite and Israelite walls on the east slope of the City of David.

salem.caption: The Temple Mount and the City of David, in an early aerial photograph.
